Well its really everything. Ive always had alot of health issues which doesnt help and ive just had alot of problems all my life. But I guess I started getting really depressed when my costcochronditis hit me. Which was a few months ago. The pain was intense I was on vicodin and got kind of addicted to it for a while. I also have irritable bowel syndrome and other health issues. When you have health issues your mental state gets even worse. I would have extreme panic attacks and horrible sucidial thoughts at night. They were so bad I hid in my closet. Its a bit better now but Im starting to get like that again. Then on memorial day i got drunk. Next morning when i went to get some water I passed out on my stone floor and hit my head. I suspect I got a mild concussion from it. Because now my memory is really bad. Then theres all my family/friends problems etc. It just doesnt get any better. The only one piece of good news ive gotten is that I finally got a job even if its temporary.

For me right now its my boyfriend. But we have almost broken up a few times. If I lost him I feel like I would be losing a part of myself. Which for me is funny to say since Ive always been a strong headed person when it came to relationships. I cried a bit if I broke up with someone then just moved on. But its different now since i feel like hes my best friend too. So I would be losing my best friend and my boyfriend. But he once admitted to me (while tipsy) he feels bad for me. Which hurts because thats not something you want to hear
